details: The scoped package @zmtcdn/ui publishes a sentinel version (9999.0.7) whose tarball contains only package.json, a 21-byte index.js stub, and postinstall.js, and whose package.json "postinstall" hook runs node postinstall.js on every install. That script builds a JSON payload containing the machine hostname, OS platform, local username, current working directory, an ISO timestamp, and Object.keys(process.env) — the NAMES of every environment variable on the build host, which in CI environments include NPM_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN, AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_SESSION_TOKEN, OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, SLACK_TOKEN, DOCKER_PASSWORD, CI_JOB_TOKEN, GITLAB_TOKEN, SENDGRID_API_KEY and HF_TOKEN — and POSTs it over HTTPS to hxxps://www[.]hinny[.]shop/api. The script transmits the variable names and their presence, not their values, and reads no files, so this version is a credential-presence reconnaissance beacon rather than a credential harvester in itself. The same postinstall script pointed at hxxps://webhook[.]site/f52af355-4783-4acb-9de1-5e44b5963025 is shipped in the sibling package @zmtcdn/components@9999.0.0.
